summary: Four long answers of 10 marks each, all compulsory, and the 2025 and 2026 papers follow the same plan. Questions ask you to build a full business model canvas for a consulting venture, compare startup vs entrepreneurship vs traditional business, discuss social and commercial entrepreneurship with the types of social enterprise, and one question on the entrepreneur (product and market perspectives in 2025, personality in 2026). Marks reward structure, every component covered, and examples.
paper_format: MST Fall 2025 and Fall 2026 (31 Aug 2026): 4 questions x 10 marks, all compulsory; time in proportion to marks.
marks_structure: 10-mark application: build a complete framework (every block of the business model canvas) with figures where needed
10-mark compare/differentiate: definitions, a comparison on clear bases (how each is set up, managed and funded), examples
10-mark classify and discuss: nature, characteristics, types, challenges and how to overcome them
repeated_topics: Business model canvas for a consultancy (digital marketing in 2025, MSME consulting in 2026)
Startup vs entrepreneurship vs business (both years)
Social entrepreneurship: perspectives, types of social enterprise, challenges (both years)
Product and market perspectives of entrepreneurship
sources: Photo of the printed MST paper, GM5204, Fall 2026 (31 Aug 2026)
